patthana22.26:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuñca naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.26:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nanahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanasappaṭigho nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Nahetu nanahetu ovattā, tīṇi mūlāni, ekavīsati pañhā kātabbā.)
